name: KUT Deliverable D
description: Kampala Uganda Temple — record-model verification close-out from proposal Section 4.4 (within 60 days of furniture installation). Refreshes the Fohlio FF&E link, validates tags, audits token-fill confidence (surfaces silent defaults), verifies LOD 500 maturity against the unified matrix (pick 'deliverable-d' at the milestone prompt), optionally stamps passing elements, assigns CSI sections and reconciles the issued SpecLink TOC, exports the asset/tag audit CSV, snapshots model health, and produces the composite compliance dashboard. LOD LADDER: Deliverable D is verified at LOD 500 (field-verified as-built), not the LOD 400 stated in the client's A1 document — 400 is fabrication/installation maturity and is covered by the separate 'construction' milestone. ORDERING DEPENDENCY — DO NOT REORDER: the Fohlio steps run BEFORE LOD_Verify because rung 500 for Furniture and Furniture Systems requires FOHLIO_REF_TXT, and Fohlio_Import is the only thing that writes it. Run the gate without them and every piece of furniture fails LOD 500 for a data-linkage reason that has nothing to do with the model's as-built accuracy. CSI_Assign likewise runs BEFORE SpecLink_Reconcile: reconciliation compares the model's CSI sections against the spec TOC, so without assignment first every section reports as a gap or over-spec. The LOD gate report under _BIM_COORD/lod_reports/ plus the audit CSV are the artefacts that accompany the record model to the Owner's catalog. Authoring stays with the design consultants; this workflow verifies, it does not author.

steps.label: 1. ISO 19650 tag validation — all 8 segments present + code-valid
2. Token-fill confidence — flags silent defaults before handover
3. Export room finishes in Fohlio shape (matched by ROOM NUMBER, not by tag)
4. Import the Fohlio FF&E register — MUST run before step 6: it is the only writer of FOHLIO_REF_TXT, which LOD 500 requires on Furniture and Furniture Systems
5. FF&E currency audit — confirms the link is fresh before the LOD gate reads it
6. LOD 500 as-built verification (pick 'deliverable-d' at the prompt) — runs AFTER the Fohlio steps, never before
7. Stamp passing elements with the verified milestone
8. Assign CSI MasterFormat sections — MUST run before step 9; reconciling without it reports every section as a gap
9. Reconcile issued SpecLink spec TOC against the model (runs AFTER step 8, never before)
